Docs/Installation

Installation

Create the Python environment, download task meshes, and check the public environment registry.

Requirements

  • Linux, conda and an NVIDIA GPU with a working Vulkan driver. CPU physics still needs a GPU renderer for image observations.
  • The release setup uses Python 3.10, ManiSkill 3.0.1, SAPIEN 3.0.3, gymnasium 0.29.1, PyTorch 2.7.1 and LeRobot 0.4.0. Keep the repository's current dependency guidance alongside the commands below.
  • Task meshes require about 0.11 GB. The OpenCabinet dataset is about 176 MB; all 30 released datasets total about 10 GB. Download checkpoints individually; their sizes are listed in Evaluation.

Source: Installation guide ↗. Run the following commands from a terminal, not from the website.

1. Clone and create the environment

git clone https://github.com/SIPAIR-Elastic/DexArena.git
cd DexArena
conda create -n ms3 python=3.10
conda activate ms3
python -m pip install datasets "lerobot==0.4.0"
python -m pip install --upgrade mani_skill "gymnasium==0.29.1" tyro swanlab h5py tensorboard coacd

LeRobot installs PyTorch. The release notes used the CUDA 12.6 default wheel; RTX 50-series cards need the CUDA 12.8 build for compute capability 12.0:

python -m pip install torch==2.7.1+cu128 torchvision==0.22.1+cu128 torchaudio==2.7.1+cu128 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
Keep the compatible versions

Retain gymnasium==0.29.1: the release-validation run found that gymnasium 1.x breaks the RLPD evaluation wrapper. PyTorch 2.7.1 is shared by the root, GR00T and OpenPI setups. Record the versions actually installed with your experiment.

2. Request dataset access

Demonstrations, task meshes and baseline checkpoints live in SIPAIR/DexArena ↗. Request access on its page once; the repository grants access automatically. Then log in from the same runtime that will perform the download. Never place your token in a script, URL or shared command log.

hf auth login

3. Download task object meshes

The meshes are not stored in Git. From the cloned repository root:

hf download SIPAIR/DexArena --repo-type dataset --include "assets/**" --local-dir tasks

The resulting directory must be tasks/assets/task_object_meshes/. The Hugging Face CLI is provided by huggingface_hub, installed with the data dependencies.

4. Check registration and one environment

import tasks registers 160 IDs: 40 tasks × four end effectors (Sharpa, Wuji, XHand and Gripper). This is 10 complete tasks and 30 stage tasks per hand, not 160 independently scored manuscript tasks. See Collection targets ↗ and Task table ↗.

import gymnasium as gym
import tasks  # registers the public task environments

env = gym.make(
    "DrawerPlugOpenDrawer-Sharpa-v1",
    obs_mode="state",
    control_mode="pd_joint_pos",
)
try:
    obs, info = env.reset(seed=0)
    print(env.action_space.shape)  # (29,): 7 arm + 22 hand targets
    obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step(env.action_space.sample())
    print("success" in info)
finally:
    env.close()

Run the public regression suite without downloading demonstrations or checkpoints:

python -m pip install pytest
python -m pytest tests -q

The release maintainers reported 291 passed and two skipped tests on 9 November; your count may change with the code revision. A successful registration or reset is an installation check, not a learned-policy result.

5. Add model-specific runtimes

BaselineRuntimeSetup
PPO, RLPD, ACT, Diffusion PolicyThe conda environment aboveUse the scripts and data preparation in Training.
GR00T N1.7libs/Isaac-GR00T/.venv with GR00T, ManiSkill and LeRobotRun bash scripts/groot/setup_env.sh; it checks out the pinned submodule and uses uv. Dataset conversion also needs ffmpeg. Request separate access to nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B. GR00T guide ↗
π0.5Python 3.11 virtual environment with pinned OpenPI/JAXFollow OpenPI installation ↗. Evaluation starts from conda and launches the JAX worker through --policy-python.

Troubleshooting and next steps

  • Unregistered ID: run from the cloned repository root and import tasks before gym.make.
  • Vulkan failure: verify the NVIDIA/Vulkan driver independently of the policy, even with physx_cpu.
  • Missing meshes: confirm the download destination in step 3.

Continue with the end-to-end tutorial, Data & replay, or the troubleshooting reference.
